properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Storage Account: Customer-Managed Key Required (Production)
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Storage Accounts without customer-managed key (CMK) encryption in production. FedRAMP High requires cryptographic protection (SC-13) and protection of information at rest (SC-28). CMK provides organization-controlled key lifecycle management via Azure Key Vault with FIPS 140-2 validated HSM backing.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Storage Accounts without CMK in production. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
